description: This file defines the 'YieldNotReadyNodeVisitor' class in the Twig templating engine, which implements node visiting logic related to yield readiness attributes in AST nodes for Twig templates.

classes.name: YieldNotReadyNodeVisitor
classes.description: A final class implementing Twig's NodeVisitorInterface for handling nodes that are not marked as yield-ready.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Processes a node when entering it; verifies if the node is marked as yield-ready and throws exceptions or triggers deprecation warnings accordingly.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Process a node when leaving it; currently returns the node unchanged.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this node visitor, which is 255.
